title: Gemini Notebook Activity Reports Now Available
summary: The Admin Reports API now allows developers to retrieve activity reports for Gemini Notebook, expanding audit and monitoring capabilities for Google Workspace.
details: Developers can now specify `gemini_notebook` as a value for the `applicationName` parameter when calling the `activities.list` method. This enables access to audit logs detailing various events within the Gemini Notebook application, providing deeper insights into user activity.
